en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a European city, showing a cobblestone avenue lined with late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings, shopfronts and signs. A horse‑drawn carriage and an electric tram marked with the number 2 travel along tram tracks in the center. Pedestrians in period clothing, several bicycles, and a dog are visible. On the left is a corner shop with the name "Hofmann". On the right are striped awnings, a hanging clock over the sidewalk, and long German‑language shop signs across the façades.
